title: Lebesgue measure of the open square (−r, r)² and the closed square [−r, r]² in ℝ²
statement: Let r ∈ ℝ with r ≥ 0, and let ℝ² = Euclid 2 = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) carry its volume (Lebesgue) measure, with coordinates v₀ = v 0 and v₁ = v 1. Then volume{v ∈ ℝ² : |v₀| < r and |v₁| < r} = 4r² and volume{v ∈ ℝ² : |v₀| ≤ r and |v₁| ≤ r} = 4r² (both as ENNReal.ofReal (4r²)).
lean_statement: ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → volume {v : Euclid 2 | |v 0| < r ∧ |v 1| < r} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * r ^ 2) ∧ volume {v : Euclid 2 | |v 0| ≤ r ∧ |v 1| ≤ r} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * r ^ 2)
